summary: Executes REALIGNMENT §2.1 (a mechanism registered with the evaluator must be observable failing and refusing) and law 8 (information at the right time); a one-line rewire of an existing branch, not a new plan. The edit-site mutation gate added in development-vessel eed9c2e9 ("refuse a check whose red no mutant of its edit site can move") refuses to arm a check with reason red_independent_of_edit_site (gap-check-supply.ts editSiteMutationGate ~:896/:920 at origin/dev d0449bf3), but the arm_refused branch (~:1218-1232) writes the ledger (state arm_refused, the reason, the mutation_gate record) and logs NOTHING: the only console line in that branch is for green_at_head. So the gate's effect is visible only in store rows; no journal reader (the operators, research's journal reads, any journal-reading detector) sees a refusal, and the gate cannot be observed working by its log. The same silence applies to the other arm_refused reasons in that branch (wrong-reason and contract-mismatch refusals). LANE: gap-check-supply.ts is lane-open in the scope, so system_first, latest_by filing + 7 days.
must_fail: An arm refusal by the edit-site mutation gate (red_independent_of_edit_site) emits exactly one journal line naming the gap and the reason.
control: An armed check logs as today (no new line for an armed check).
